question: River _______ flows through the Malwa Plateau.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Betwa.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Betwa river**__

 __
 
• **​​**__Northern India's Betwa River, also known as** Vetravati (Sanskrit for "Containing Reeds"),** rises in the** Vindhya Range** just to the north of **Hoshangabad**, Madhya Pradesh. After travelling** 380 miles (610 km) across the states of Uttar Pradesh and Madhya Pradesh,** it drains into the Yamuna River just east of Hamirpur. Before entering the Bundelkhand highland, about half of its impassable path crosses the **Malwa Plateau.** The principal tributaries are the **Jamni and Dhasan rivers. Both Dukwan and Deogarh have dammed the Betwa.**
